snippet.title: Greda Inferno - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Try Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4583150/Greda_Inferno/

You are Nestor, a renowned potter who lives in the south of the world. One ordinary day, your life takes a brutal turn. You arrive in Hell under mysterious circumstances. You must survive at all costs, and along the way, familiarize yourself with your new town, trying to find a way out of the abyss.

Developer: ChangoMangoEXP
